about_the_game:
An inviting figure on the TV encourages you to play a strange card game.

Not that you have much of a choice, anyway.

Based on a popular Italian game, similar to blackjack, in a horror-like ambient and a small twist, winch will keep you attached to the screen for a while.

HOW TO PLAY?

CONTROLS:

  • W A S D – to look around

  • Left Click – Select / Use / Continue dialogue

  • Right Click – Inspect card/object

GOALS:

  • Beat the dealer’s score without going over 7.5 points

  • Click in front of you or on the deck to draw a card

  • Press the red button to pass and end the round

  • Win as many rounds as possible until the end

PLAYING TIME:

  • ~ 20 minutes (with a bit of luck)
